Can my vamp, tapped with 0 blood, use a forced awakening to try to

Jaysen

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <359A88A9...@internorth.com>, Jaysen Knight
<jay...@internorth.com> writes

>Can my vamp, tapped with 0 blood, use a forced awakening to try to
>block? What happens if I fail?
>

The card has no requirements for untapping about the amount of blood you
have so yes, you can.

If you fail, you burn one blood. You have no blood so ignore it.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jaysen Knight wrote:
> Can my vamp, tapped with 0 blood, use a forced awakening to try to
> block? What happens if I fail?

Yes. If he fails to block, he burns a blood. As always, a vampire
ignores "burn blood" effects in excess of his blood supply, so
nothing happens.
